title: Diagnosing mechanisms to mitigate anion exchange ionomer degradation during impure water electrolysis
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE03891J, Paper
Isabela Rios Amador, Ryan T. Hannagan, Allen Qiang, Sang-Won Lee, Nhi Thi Thu Tran, Kyra M. K. Yap, Ashton M. Aleman, Daniela H. Marin, Milenia Rojas Mendoza, Michaela Burke Stevens, Thomas F. Jaramillo, Adam C. Nielander
We analyzed chemical and electrochemical degradation products and pathways of PiperION under oxidizing conditions in saline electrolyte to gain understanding toward ionomer degradation under impure water electrolysis.
